title: Strawberry Granita
summary: Sweet strawberry purée sharpened with lemon, frozen in a shallow dish and raked with a fork into bright red, fluffy ice crystals.
equipment: 33 x 23 cm glass or metal dish

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the syrup
steps.text: Stir the sugar into the warm water in the jug until completely dissolved. Dissolving it first means no gritty sugar in the finished ice.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blitz the strawberries with the syrup, lemon juice and salt for 1-2 min until perfectly smooth.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Press the purée through the sieve into the dish to remove the seeds. A shallow layer freezes faster and more evenly.

steps.title: First freeze
steps.text: Freeze, uncovered, for about 1 h, until the edges are icy and the centre is slushy.

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Rake the frozen edges with the fork and stir the crystals into the slushy middle. Repeat every 30-60 min, breaking up any lumps, for 2-3 h more, until the whole dish is dry, light flakes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rake once more just before serving and pile into chilled glasses with a halved strawberry.

tips: Do not skip the scraping: left alone, granita sets into a solid block.
Use a metal dish for the fastest freezing.
If it does freeze hard, leave it out for 10 min and rake again.
storage: Keep frozen in a covered container for up to 1 week; rake with a fork to loosen before serving.
